about: Openly licensed images from Wikimedia Commons, resized to at most 640 px. Show the credit_line wherever an image appears.

photos.caption: A spadenose shark laid on a white board with a ruler for scale.
photos.author: Hariprasad Shetty10
photos.credit_line: A spadenose shark laid on a white board with a ruler for scale. Photo: Hariprasad Shetty10, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.notes: Taken in a fish market in Mangaluru, on the Karnataka coast.

photos.caption: Spadenose sharks in a woven basket after capture.
photos.author: Unknown author (iNaturalist observer), released under CC0
photos.credit_line: Spadenose sharks in a woven basket after capture. Photo: Unknown author (iNaturalist observer), released under CC0, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.notes: Imported from an iNaturalist observation dated 5 Jan 2024; the place is not stated on Commons.

photos.caption: Milk sharks on a wharf in Mangalore, Karnataka.
photos.author: Karunakar Rayker from India
photos.credit_line: Milk sharks on a wharf in Mangalore, Karnataka. Photo: Karunakar Rayker from India, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.notes: The Flickr author changed the licence on Flickr after the upload. Commons keeps the CC BY 2.0 licence that was reviewed and valid at upload.

photos.caption: Milk sharks at a market in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
photos.author: hewyk
photos.credit_line: Milk sharks at a market in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Photo: hewyk, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

photos.caption: A young grey bamboo shark in an aquarium tank, with dark bands across its back.
photos.author: Mbrickn
photos.credit_line: A young grey bamboo shark in an aquarium tank, with dark bands across its back. Photo: Mbrickn, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.notes: Captive animal in a university aquarium in Ohio, USA. The banding is typical of young animals.

photos.caption: A grey bamboo shark seen from above among rocks and algae.
photos.author: Silke Baron from Vienna, Austria
photos.credit_line: A grey bamboo shark seen from above among rocks and algae. Photo: Silke Baron from Vienna, Austria, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.notes: Commons describes it as off Malaysia, and its category is Fish of Malaysia.

photos.caption: A scalloped hammerhead swimming in open blue water off Jarvis Island.
photos.author: Kevin Lino, NOAA/NMFS/PIFSC/ESD (NOAA Photo Library)
photos.credit_line: A scalloped hammerhead swimming in open blue water off Jarvis Island. Photo: Kevin Lino, NOAA/NMFS/PIFSC/ESD (NOAA Photo Library), Public domain (US government work), via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.notes: A work of the US government (NOAA), so it is in the public domain. Photographer: Kevin Lino, NOAA/NMFS/PIFSC/ESD.

photos.caption: A scalloped hammerhead swimming off Costa Rica.
photos.author: Kris-Mikael Krister
photos.credit_line: A scalloped hammerhead swimming off Costa Rica. Photo: Kris-Mikael Krister, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

photos.caption: The first published drawing of the Ganges shark, from Muller and Henle's 1839 book on sharks and rays.
photos.author: Johannes Muller and Jacob Henle (1839)
photos.credit_line: The first published drawing of the Ganges shark, from Muller and Henle's 1839 book on sharks and rays. Illustration: Johannes Muller and Jacob Henle (1839), Public domain (published 1839), via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.notes: Illustration, not a photograph. The shark appears under its old name Carcharias gangeticus. No openly licensed photograph of a Ganges shark was found on Commons.

photos.caption: A line drawing of the Ganges shark from an FAO guide.
photos.author: FAO
photos.credit_line: A line drawing of the Ganges shark from an FAO guide. Illustration: FAO, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

photos.caption: A spotted eagle ray swimming near a reef.
photos.author: Jerome Paillet (IFREMER)
photos.credit_line: A spotted eagle ray swimming near a reef. Photo: Jerome Paillet (IFREMER), CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

photos.caption: An Indian Ocean humpback dolphin breaking the surface off Oman.
photos.author: pavlaki1968
photos.credit_line: An Indian Ocean humpback dolphin breaking the surface off Oman. Photo: pavlaki1968, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.notes: Contrast animal (not a shark). Commons gives the place as Oman.

photos.caption: Two clownfish among the tentacles of a sea anemone.
photos.author: Don Kitson
photos.credit_line: Two clownfish among the tentacles of a sea anemone. Photo: Don Kitson, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
